children: United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund reported that its parent’s ultimate owner, The Marygold Companies, entered a definitive all-cash agreement on Sep 25, 2026 to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners. Marygold owns USCF Investments, the holding company of United States Commodity Funds, the fund’s general partner. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to stockholder and regulatory approvals, after which Marygold’s shares will be delisted. The parties said the deal will enable execution of Marygold’s transformation strategy to refocus USCF’s business; completion is not guaranteed.
: Support transformation strategy and refocus USCF's business
